evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies socket polling in src/net.cpp to avoid busy loops in the network event loop.
rationale: Prevents CPU-exhausting busy loops in the network event loop caused by unhandled TCP urgent data in select(). As noted in commit 1c27aa5bef, select() continuously reports TCP urgent indications when recv() has no data to read, causing a busy loop unless exceptional conditions disconnect the peer or are ignored.
